items.title: Implement tenant total (RQ-FXL-0003)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.total so reporting can show a tenant's total.

items.title: Implement addEntry validation (RQ-FXL-0001, RQ-FXL-0002)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.addEntry with the validation rules and stored form of new entries.

items.title: Implement entry approval (RQ-FXL-0004)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.approve. Uses sessions and roles from fx-identity.

items.title: Fix balance cut-off bug (RQ-FXL-0005)
items.description: Customers report that entries dated on the statement date are missing from the balance. Fix FxLedger.Ledger.balance without breaking existing behaviour.

items.title: Implement ledger view (RQ-FXL-0006)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.view for the ledger screen.

items.title: Implement CSV export (RQ-FXL-0007)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.exportCsv for the partner import.

items.title: Implement currency conversion (RQ-FXL-0008)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.convertCurrency so amounts can be shown in other currencies.

items.title: Implement refunds (RQ-FXL-0009)
items.description: Implement FxLedger.Ledger.refund. See EV-FXL-0003 for background.
